In this unit you learn to recognize the connotation of Arabic press words, the most frequent idiomatic metaphors and expressions, the signals of implicit (presumptions, ironic quotes, rhetorical questions, irony) and the way to translate them without mitigating or exaggerating them. Three weeks, in parallel with EGY-15 and the beginning of ARZ-01.

Targets. At the end of the lesson you know:
1. place the words of printing on a neutral/positive/negative scale and choose the Italian equivalent the same level;
2. recognizing and translating about twenty metaphors and idiomatic expressions in printing;
3. Identifying assumptions ( ⁧أَخِيرًا⁩ , ⁧مَرَّةً أُخْرَى⁩ , ⁧مَا زَالَ⁩ , ⁧حَتَّى⁩ ) and what they suggest;
4. recognizing ironic quotes, rhetorical questions and irony;
5. to say, in a note of analysis, what a text suggests without saying it, distinguishing it from what he says. Three-week plan.
